rule: At least 3 evaluable samples including 2 high-effort confirmations; at least 2 substantive failures on a track, including one high-effort failure; explicit visual/evidence review by an identified reviewer (human or assistant).
clarification: The frozen initial task manifest used the phrase human review. Before inspecting any model output, this policy clarifies that recorded assistant visual/evidence review is acceptable. No prompts, references, numeric tolerances or failure-count thresholds changed.
